authority.commit_note: The commit containing the addition and this file is the registration; it did not exist when this file was written and is recorded by the signed readiness document before the gate.

base_forecast: the saved raw native deciles of each model, repaired as in Study 1; no refitting

fallback.name: pypi
fallback.reason: operational_nyc311_unavailability_only; recorded before any target scoring; never performance or an unfilled stratum
fallback.source: ClickPy, under Study 2's registered PyPI rules, same strata and seeds

primary.completeness: a day is complete when the capture of that day's requests is exhausted; a calendar day with zero requests across the whole enumerated frame is a source gap, not a zero, and stops the domain before any scoring
primary.counts: requests by creation date, America/New_York with DST, deduplicated by request identifier, latest captured revision per identifier; requests, not closures
primary.exclusions: missing or unrecognized board codes excluded with counts
primary.frame: the whole eligible inventory of 2024 (no candidate pool)
primary.name: nyc311

gate: Study 2's gate requirements unchanged: signed readiness bound to the addition's commit, smoke at HEAD, clean committed tree, separate target-access and runtime approvals, committed comparison file, checkpoints with hashes, committed inference command, per-row recomputation, capture ledger; NYC Open Data terms recorded before publication
secondary: hurdle_fixed and occurrence_model_size_count against the completed control and the count hurdles per stratum
the pooled 300-series tables in Study 2's form
Brier, discrete CRPS with its availability rule, randomized PIT
leave-one-out and concentration descriptors per stratum
seed_derivation: SHA-256 of canonical JSON, as Study 2's inference command, with the component name study3

strata.selection: first 100 complete series per stratum in selection-hash order; reduced strata reported; no transfer of slots

variant_definitions.completed: the control: the completed-unwrapped forecast, as registered for Study 2
variant_definitions.hurdle_dynamic: the occurrence probability of the registered dynamic_count law at each lead (discounted Beta-Bernoulli, discount 0.98, a_B = b_B = 0.5) with the completed positive law; delta_1 only when F(0) = 1
variant_definitions.hurdle_fixed: Study 2's hurdle: the 28-day Jeffreys occurrence with the completed positive law
variant_definitions.occurrence_model_size_count: the model's own completed occurrence 1 - F(0) with hurdle_count_28's positive law
